title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Action-conditioned video world models require low-latency causal generation and reliable responses to game-native controls. Although causal distillation enables one- or few-step video synthesis, extending it to interactive world models remains challenging, as discrete keyboard states and continuous mouse motion must remain aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks during causal training and autoregressive rollout. We introduce ForgeWM, a progressive framework that transforms a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into efficient few-step world models through domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching with a bidirectional teacher. The resulting budget-specialized students operate at steady-state denoising budgets of 1, 2, and 4 steps. translated_title: ForgeWM：用于少步动作条件视频世界模型的渐进式因果训练
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14022v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：动作条件视频世界模型需要低延迟的因果生成和对游戏原生控制的可靠响应。尽管因果蒸馏能够实现一步或几步的视频合成，但将其扩展到交互式世界模型仍具有挑战性，因为在因果训练和自回归滚动过程中，离散的键盘状态和连续的鼠标运动必须与时间压缩的潜在块保持对齐。我们引入了ForgeWM，这是一个渐进式框架，通过领域自适应、教师强制因果训练、因果一致性蒸馏以及双向教师在线策略分布匹配，将双向动作条件视频生成器转变为高效的少步世界模型。由此产生的预算特化学生在稳态去噪预算为1、2和4步下运行。ForgeWM进一步支持双路径部署协议，结合延迟关键交互与可选增强。
tldr: ForgeWM通过渐进式因果训练框架，将双向动作条件视频生成器转化为高效少步世界模型，实现了低延迟交互与稳定生成。
en_tdlr: ForgeWM transforms bidirectional action-conditioned video generators into efficient few-step world models through progressive causal training, enabling low-latency interaction and stable generation.
